_about: Upwork Project Catalog cut (must be 60 s or less) of the WhatsApp Commerce V2 video, built by bin/demo upwork (see README.md). Client-oriented: what was built, the real WhatsApp interaction (the author's phone recordings: browsing, ordering, the app's receipt and confirmation; rendered by motion.mjs), how it works, the operator dashboard (SYNTHETIC demo data, introduced by the 'Application demo · synthetic data' card and tagged DEMO DATA on every local frame), real verification and deployment, a project closing card. No website, email, phone number or other contact details, no URLs, no third-party logos, no evidence file names, no claim of long-term production reliability. Voice: Kokoro-82M af_heart at speed 0.95.

A WhatsApp commerce integration, built to be operated.
